scenes.text: One class recording holds many moments worth sharing. Reel Studio finds them for you.
Start from the dashboard. Upload a recording, or create a video from just a topic.
Drop in a class. Reel Studio transcribes the Hinglish on your own machine, and corrects technical terms like useEffect, using the code on screen.
It ranks complete thirty to sixty second moments, explains why each one works, and reframes the widescreen class into a readable vertical reel.
No recording? Type a topic like JSON versus XML, and get an editable script, animated code and a natural voiceover.
Then fine tune it in the editor. Trim clips, edit captions word by word, apply your brand and a style, and render a new MP4.
When it is ready, publish straight to Instagram, or schedule it for later.
